title: GitLab CI: Temporarily disable some Falco plugins
description:
Temporarily disable the gcpaudit and k8saudit plugins in the package
builders until we can figure out why the macOS tests are failing.

commits_data.title: GitLab CI: Temporarily disable some Falco plugins
commits_data.message:
GitLab CI: Temporarily disable some Falco plugins

Temporarily disable the gcpaudit and k8saudit plugins in the package
builders until we can figure out why the macOS tests are failing.
